changelog:
Initial release.

- Fetch news, earthquakes, Iran events, tech, finance, layoffs from World Monitor
- Query by topic or keyword with flexible time (30min, 3h, 2d)
- Bilingual (EN/中文), no API key required
- 3-step install: clone → npm install + setup → fetch
